issue_types.description: URLs use http:// instead of https://.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and build canonical / sitemap / Open Graph URLs from the https domain.

issue_types.issue: Sitemap URLs point to a local/development host
issue_types.description: URLs point to localhost / a development host instead of the live domain.
issue_types.expected_value: Absolute https URLs on the production domain
issue_types.recommended_fix: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the live https domain for production builds and rebuild.

issue_types.description: The page declares a different URL as canonical, so this URL will not be indexed.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Set alternates.canonical to the page's own URL, or remove this URL from the sitemap/links if it is a duplicate.

issue_types.description: The page is live and linked on the site but is not listed in sitemap.xml, so search engines may discover it late.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add the route to src/app/sitemap.ts (or its data source) and rebuild.

issue_types.description: The URL redirects to another URL. Linking to (or listing) a redirecting URL costs an extra request and dilutes link signals.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Replace the link / sitemap entry with the final URL shown in Current value.
